data.name: Sadikul
data.gender_notes: Sadikul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who is with you through thick and thin, a loyal companion and friend. The name Sadikul carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sadikul usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is always there for you on your spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Sadikul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadikul total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The name "Sadikul" signifies a strong bond of friendship and loyalty, implying that the person named Sadikul is someone who can be relied upon through all circumstances, a true companion.

The spiritual significance of the name "Sadikul" reflects these virtues and reminds the bearer to strive towards living a life that is truthful and true to their values.
